method: Read all raw_text columns in comparison-index order, 16 batches of two layers, every tool response ended with full END LAYERS marker without tool truncation; open-ended semantic notes, no scoring or keyword substitution
limitations: Model-assisted reading, not independent human blinded review
Identity coverage verifies which evidence was read, not semantic correctness
Generated 128-token truncation is preserved; no continuation
One channel per layer and eight familiar exploratory questions do not establish whole-layer function or general capability preservation
